physical_input_preflight: Before either lifecycle mutates beta, require three uppercase country letters, applicant object, string-valued MRZ, optional TD1/TD2/TD3, DG1 and DG2 plus only ASCII-numbered DG keys with nonempty canonical base64. This deliberately narrows acceptance inputs; it does not change the released application parser.
successful_execution: Each of the nine ordered steps is read and advanced through Gateway; the terminal instance is COMPLETED and the track-production result reached QUALITY_CHECK or READY_FOR_ACTIVATION.
execution_relationship: The existing direct Gateway lifecycle and this Flow execution create separate jobs. Even when tenant and release match, their evidence must remain distinct and cannot qualify a single nine-route end-to-end chain.
provider_callback: A public job state cannot authenticate callback origin. Require a future protected ingress receipt binding the real provider profile, tenant, bureau job, signed-body digest, signing policy, and deployed source before this gate can be verified.
simulator: The beta bureau is nonphysical and cannot satisfy the real-provider callback gate.
default: The physical Flow probe is opt-in; the aggregate beta acceptance remains blocked.
